description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: Extend WebBridge capability declarations and file execution integration, Delivery dispatch/executor only at their existing extension boundaries, and web response contracts. BO/widget attachment deliveries use PR4 plans and PR5 execution/confirmation. Publish safe descriptors tied to canonical message attachment identities, with session-protected download URLs. Preserve configured limits, source identity and history reload. Clarify receipts as descriptor publication, not proof the user downloaded bytes; acquisition happens through the appropriate existing delivery or authorized file-read path. No duplicate planner/executor.

Tests to add before implementation: Integration through deliver_outgoing for web and widget, ordered multiple files, empty attachments, provider/acquisition errors, limits, partial outcomes, confirmation/persistence and history replay. Test descriptor fields are supported by the actual widget protocol.

Branches/paths validated: BO versus widget connector resolution, text-only and attachment messages, both source types, failed publication, confirmed-only history and no resend on report failure.

Mocking plan: External provider edges; real delivery/Engine internals and package protocol fixtures.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content: docs/services/channels.md and web-bridge.md; capabilities, descriptor contract and confirmation semantics.

Action reuse assessment: Extend WebBridge and existing PR4/PR5 owners. Inputs remain Outgoing.attachments plus trusted routing; outputs existing delivery receipts and safe web descriptors. No Action or Agent transport logic. Reuse canonical history rather than a parallel attachment store.

Implementation handoff: Scope and sequence approved by the user on 2026-11-28. This turn records the plan only; application implementation, commits, pushes, rebases and dependency publication are not performed or authorized by this planning update. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md before execution. Read applicable service guides and module responsibilities; Agent work requires the harness-critical checks; BO work requires DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md. Recheck live source and dependency contracts. Preserve existing test behavior unless specifically approved. Write immediate unit/integration/property tests before corresponding code; new browser journeys wait for the human UX gate. Keep real internal boundaries, mock only external edges, and inject runtime dependencies through existing opts/context and Zaq.Config. Follow the owning validation lifecycle. PR7 owns RunAgent, NotifyPerson and notification/workflow integration.

comments.text: Upstream source/history blocker tracked separately as zaq-9j8.19, owner ../zaq-feat-delivery-execution at 2144608e7. Confirmed delivery currently discards durable source metadata. No PR5 source patch is made in PR6; continue independent retrieval/protocol/presentation implementation while retaining this full history/download acceptance gate.

BO attachment execution has an evidenced upstream selection gap: shared Connection.select requires a persisted :web connector even though existing BO delivery uses the explicit config-free branch. Reproducer /tmp/pr6-pr5-bo-connection-gap_test.exs returns channel_not_configured; no PR5 production code patched. Safe historical widget descriptor projection proceeds through existing response path; capability enablement and full execution remain gated by owner fix, zaq-9j8.19 source preservation and published widget companion contract. Existing web file capability assertion approval requested, not assumed.

Safe historical descriptor projection implemented as Web.Attachments.project/2 and reused by widget history and BO display; no raw source attrs/handles reach browser descriptors. Property tests prove closed fields and original stored indices. Full web executor enablement is not implemented around the upstream gaps: zaq-9j8.19 drops durable source; zaq-9j8.20 cannot select BO virtual transport. No modifications to PR4/PR5 delivery infrastructure, Factory or PR5 worktree. Compatible widget release/pin and existing capability-test approval also pending. Do not claim file readiness from the prepared frontend or hand-constructed historical fixtures.

title: [zaq-pi3.14] Enable attachment execution and descriptors for web delivery
